known_limitations: Binance USDT pairs including delisted ones still described by exchangeInfo (190 delisted/halted bases); pairs Binance dropped from exchangeInfo entirely are absent
prices are split-adjusted by the source, not dividend-adjusted
daily bars only: no intraday path, no halts (US LULD) or order-book depth
costs are assumed per price tier (profiles.py), not measured spreads
sessions are UTC days; the asset trades 24/7

tiers.survivorship: Binance USDT pairs including delisted ones still described by exchangeInfo (190 delisted/halted bases); pairs Binance dropped from exchangeInfo entirely are absent

execution.corporate_actions: source prices are split-adjusted; no reference resets are expected or scaled

jump_ratio.note: a session whose close/reference ratio is beyond this inside (entry, exit] is a redenomination or a bad print, not a trade; such trades are EXCLUDED_DATA_JUMP for the rule and the baselines alike

execution.plan_text: sell short at the first open in s+1..s+3 that is above the signal close (into a bounce); buy back at the first close above its own reference price (an up day), else at the close of the 2th session after entry; carry charged per session held
execution.price: signal at close of s, entry at the open of s + entry_lag, exit at a close

short_side.liquidation_note: isolated margin: liquidated at the first session whose high is 100% above the entry, losing that fraction of the sold notional plus fees and carry
short_side.note: short side assumed: a perpetual-futures short at the spot reference price, funding 0.05% per UTC day paid by the short (a conservative stand-in: after a pump longs usually pay), 0.1% fee + 0.1% slippage per side; perpetuals may not exist for every pair, and liquidation risk is not modelled

lookahead_check.sandbox: file, network, process, frame and heap access blocked during compute

market.cost_assumption: costs assumed: 0.1% taker fee + 0.1% slippage per side; sessions are UTC days

random.method: same session, uniform over names where the rule was evaluable, same execution

listing_age.description: sessions since first panel session: <60 / <250 / older or censored at the panel start

market_cap.availability: TIER_1, TIER_2 (no share counts after the mirror ends)
market_cap.description: quintile of close x IDX listed shares

volatility.description: tercile of 20-session std of daily log returns

not_available.board: listing board known only as of the 2025-02 snapshot; not point-in-time, so not used
not_available.free_float: IDX tradeble_shares equals listed_shares for most names; it is not free float, so not used
not_available.sector: only a 2025-02 snapshot (List Emiten/Sectors); not point-in-time, so not used

random_matched.method: same session, same price_band / liquidity / market_cap / volatility / momentum / drawdown / listing_age buckets as the signalled name (relaxed from the last feature when fewer than 5 names match), same execution

rule.text: Experiment E4 (the fade): one of the E2 family's already-ran detectors G2_RET30, G1_RET20_CLOSEHIGH, G10_RET15_CLOSEHIGH, G7_MOMENTUM5_30 (research/E2/protocol.json) traded on the SHORT side with one execution plan from the family in research/E4/protocol.json, the pair selected on the discovery period by the rule pre-registered there. Signal at the close of session d when the detector holds; the short entry and its cover as the plan says. Selected under KOD-GLOBAL-E4-v2: G2_RET30_BEAR; side short; plan: entry pullback within 3 session(s), exit first_up, hold 2.
